independent_reviewer: ChatGPT (via Frank-as-relay per new operating model)

target_environment.auth_method_required: claude.ai firstParty (existing operator credentials only; no new auth)

test_sequence.prompt: Reconstruct the application per the system prompt. When you are ready, state that you are ready.

capture_discipline_v02.primary: claude [flags] > FILE 2>stderr; post-call jq . FILE && jq empty FILE; sha256sum FILE; size must exceed 1 KB and must NOT be a multiple of 8192
capture_discipline_v02.fallback: claude --output-format stream-json [flags] 2>stderr | python3 capture.py FILE; capture.py reads entire stream into FILE
capture_discipline_v02.rationale: 004 captured via 'tee FILE | head -c 200' which produced SIGPIPE truncation at 8 KiB kernel pipe-buffer boundary on tests 2 and 3; this v0.2 capture discipline eliminates the pipe-consumer surface
capture_discipline_v02.gate_per_turn: jq . FILE must succeed before extraction step; jq failure defaults to BLOCKED

experiment_level_dispositions.PASS: all three per-test PASS AND no material contamination/repair/fallback/evidence-capture defect
experiment_level_dispositions.PARTIAL: >=1 PARTIAL but none FAIL, no material contamination
experiment_level_dispositions.INDETERMINATE: isolation, evidence-capture, or execution defects prevent reliable interpretation
experiment_level_dispositions.BLOCKED: target cannot be executed per protocol's BLOCKED rule

preflight_checklist.requirement: Fresh isolated target context, no prior Amazing Birthday memory
Frozen-source verification of transcript blob and withheld test/rubric hashes
Exact target model identifier frozen before reconstruction
Capture-pipeline smoke test: jq . accepts one-shot test envelope of >=1 KB non-multiple-of-8192 bytes

preflight_blocked_rule: If any requirement cannot be demonstrated, return BLOCKED. Do not initiate login, install paid services, create credentials, purchase/change subscriptions, weaken isolation, or substitute providers/models.
freeze_no_repair_rules: Freeze when target reconstructs reusable behavior from transcript and states readiness.
Atomically preserve first reconstruction and first response to each test, with jq-verified JSON envelope, before any extraction.
No correction, hint, regeneration, clarification, prompt repair, model fallback, or provider fallback before all raw first outputs are preserved.
Lost/truncated/re-issued first-call evidence makes the run INDETERMINATE.

comparator_paired_with_replication_002.pairing_question: Does the canonical transcript alone preserve enough behavioral identity to pass the same frozen v1.0 withheld tests that the two-artifact durability package passed at 19/19/17 in replication 002?

interpretation_limit: A PASS in 005 supports only the narrower claim that a transcript-only input is sufficient in the recorded Claude environment under this frozen protocol. It does not generalize cross-provider, cross-application, or to the durability package's necessity. The paired comparison with replication 002 is directional on artifact-dependence and not a universality claim.
